tools.name: domain_score
tools.description: One risk verdict for a domain or host: score 0-100, level low/medium/high and plain reasons (domain age, registry hold status, missing or expired certificate, no mail records, missing DMARC), built from live DNS, RDAP and a TLS handshake. Use before opening a link, trusting a sender or paying a vend

tools.name: domain_score_batch
tools.description: The domain_score verdict for up to 20 domains in one call and one payment, results per domain (a domain that could not be read is listed with its error). $0.04 USDC per call via x402; not charged when no domain could be read.

tools.name: dns_records
tools.description: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS and CNAME records for a domain from public resolvers. $0.002 USDC per call via x402; a lookup failure is not charged.

tools.name: rdap_lookup
tools.description: Registrar, created and expiry dates, age in days and status codes for a registered domain, read from its registry over RDAP. $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: ssl_certificate
tools.description: Issuer, subject, valid-from and expiry, days left and the SAN list of the certificate a host serves (TLS handshake). $0.002 USDC per call via x402.
